rows.title: A spouse as paid caregiver: Structured Family Caregiving only

values.program: CIH Waiver and Health & Wellness / TBI waivers (not a Family Supports Waiver service)
values.conditions: A spouse, or a parent of a minor, is a legally responsible individual and may be paid ONLY under Structured Family Caregiving: a per diem paid through a DDARS-approved provider agency, never directly, and only for extraordinary care beyond what the spouse would ordinarily provide. A spouse may NOT be paid under Attendant Care, Home and Community Assistance, Respite, or Participant-Directed Home Care. Claim notes must show the true spouse relationship.

rows.source: DDARS HCBS Waivers Provider Manual, Sections 9.30 and 11.28 (Structured Family Caregiving; legally responsible individuals)
